scenario: LCON.2.7.1 float determinism — subtraction. `0.3 - 0.1` is the IEEE 754 double 0.19999999999999998, not 0.2. The guard `(t.a - t.b) == 0.19999999999999998` fires only on an exact bit match; fact_count 2 confirms.
rules_ds:
schema T scope logical:
    a: Float key
    b: Float mutable

schema Hit scope logical:
    d: Int key

rule r:
    T t where (t.a - t.b) == 0.19999999999999998
->
    emit Hit logical d: 0
